independent_regression.access: Evaluate only after correction algorithm/code hash is frozen. No score/reference cases used to design correction.

pixel_convention: Pixel index centers at integer coordinates; pixel (0,0) center=(0,0); corresponding edges=(-0.5,-0.5)..(0.5,0.5). Pillow bbox endpoints are half-open indices.
design_outline_center: Font-unit glyph min/max midpoint, transformed y-up to y-down at explicit baseline; not raster or optical center
raster_bbox_center: ((xmin+xmax-1)/2,(ymin+ymax-1)/2) of all strictly nonzero alpha pixels
coverage_centroid: sum(pixel-index-coordinate * alpha)/sum(alpha); diagnostic only, not target or pass criterion
optical_center: UNDEFINED; requires separate perceptual/music engraving validation
criterion: Absolute raster-bbox center minus target <=0.5 px on EACH axis; unchanged. Evaluate mask pixels independently of helper-reported residuals.
controls: Translated glyph alpha dimensions and values must not change under proposed correction
candidate_rule_if_supported: Rasterize each unchanged glyph/font/size once at an integer baseline; retain its exact nonzero-alpha bitmap. Use that bitmap's pixel-index bbox center as explicit raster-placement anchor. Integer-translate with nearest-grid rounding (ties toward +infinity), no resizing/thresholding, preserving shape and coverage. Derived per-glyph/size, never a constant score-tuned offset. Discard fractional baseline phase intentionally and report that design change.
additional_regression: At fixed synthetic staff crossings verify nonempty head/stem and required ledger contacts, no unrelated-group collision, no clipping; deterministic mask hashes. No glyph optical-center assertion.
score_gate: Only after every held-out synthetic case and controls pass: NEW run identity, same frozen source semantics/selection measures3/32, A -1/G -3; unchanged pitch/staff computations and full guard. Freeze outputs and compare GT-04 history, never overwrite it.
failure: Do not change cases, font, sizes or 0.5px criterion after results. No new score render if synthetic gate fails.
scope: Research helper only; no production renderer, ownership promotion or independent musical accuracy claim
